events.body:
## Summary

Add the final reliability and quality pass for the Git-native BLT-Jobs platform workstreams.

## Scope

- Static build reliability.
- Data loading and fallback behavior.
- Accessibility checks.
- Responsive checks.
- No-console-error manual QA.
- CI/validation commands.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run build:jobs` passes.
- [ ] `npm run validate:jobs` passes.
- [ ] Homepage, jobs, job detail, seekers, seeker detail, saved jobs, and add/profile flows load without console errors.
- [ ] Public pages use generated data correctly and have graceful fallbacks.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and focus states work for main interactions.
- [ ] Mobile layouts are checked for filters, cards, nav, and submission flows.
- [ ] Document manual QA checklist under `docs/`.

## Parent

Tracked by #12: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/2

---
